svg.title: PieMaker — Life Pies
svg.desc: A transparent PICEUS-style animation with vivid blue, yellow, pink, cyan, violet, coral, green, and teal slices. Five dramatically different illustrative allocation profiles shift smoothly inside a fixed pie. Bold category labels and markers follow their slices, and rolling percentage labels track each allocation. Each profile totals 100 percent. This is a design illustration, not live personal data.
